Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes with a Breakable Extended Release Gliclazide Formulation in Primary Care: The Xrise Study. This study examines whether a new, scored and breakable once daily gliclazide tablet formulation, gliclazide XR 60 mg, that enables a simple 2-steps titration, can improve glycemic control rates in the community.
